description: This file defines classes and functions for generating and updating project dependency graphs in a Gradle-based Android project, including tasks for dumping graph data and updating Markdown files with Mermaid diagrams.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Class responsible for generating project dependency graphs by traversing Gradle project dependencies, and providing methods to retrieve dependencies and plugin information.

classes.name: PluginType
classes.description: Enum representing different plugin types with associated identifiers, references, and styles for graph visualization.

classes.name: GraphDumpTask
classes.description: Task that dumps project dependencies into a Mermaid-compatible format for visualization.

classes.name: GraphUpdateTask
classes.description: Task that updates a Markdown file with the generated dependency graph and legend.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main method in Graph class that recursively collects dependencies and plugin info starting from a root project.

methods.name: dependencies
methods.description: Returns a map of project paths to their dependencies in a structured format.

methods.name: plugins
methods.description: Returns a map of project paths to their plugin types.

methods.name: configureGraphTasks
methods.description: Configures Gradle tasks for generating and updating dependency graphs.

methods.name: mermaid
methods.description: Generates a Mermaid diagram string representing project dependencies.

methods.name: legend
methods.description: Generates a legend string for the dependency graph visualization.

methods.name: classDef
methods.description: Defines a class style for a plugin type in Mermaid syntax.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Creates a Mermaid link string between projects based on dependency configuration.

methods.name: alias
methods.description: Creates a Mermaid node alias with styling based on plugin type.

methods.name: trimTrailingNewLines
methods.description: Removes trailing blank lines from a string.
